acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Flame Elementals family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Blaze Warden, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Jet-Gate Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: White-hot central flame with blue edges, two arms shaped into directed jets, and a strong heat-shimmer aura.
Signature mechanic: Twin Jet Gate: one arm becomes a sweeping jet while the other compacts into a bright guard; the roles reverse after each sweep.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a lane controller that reshapes both arms into alternating directed jets.
constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity living fire, heat, smoke, obsidian, molten rock, and base scorching are the source body's ordinary construction and environmental behavior, not evidence of engineered Fire affinity.
Native temperature color, cinders, heat shimmer, upward dissolution, and source cores remain bounded to the form with no added elemental apparatus.
counterplay: Enter behind the sweeping nozzle and strike the exposed core edge before the two arms reverse. Affinity signal: The native flicker base, smoke arm, directed jet throat, obsidian fissure, or sovereign star rhythm preserves each established opening.
forbiddenTreatments: Labeling the family body itself as a Fire-affinity modification
identityInvariants: A roughly humanoid upper silhouette dissolves into flame above and tapers or hovers below with no feet.
Temperature remains legible from dull orange through yellow-white to blue-white edges.
Open flame, ember, smoke, and later source-supported obsidian and molten rock stay materially distinct.
Core definition and directed combustion progress from a flicker to a sovereign star while heat remains readable rather than overexposed.
telegraph: One arm narrows to a blue-edged nozzle while the white-hot core leans toward the opposite arm.
